profile.highSchoolName: Thomas Jefferson High School for Science and Technology

rationale.intuition: Stanford overall RD ~3.7%; strong unhooked domestic 通常 3-10%. TJHSST (Thomas Jefferson HSST) 是 #1 公立 magnet HS, Stanford historical feeder rate ~6-9% (vs ~3.7% national avg). 真实 industry 估计 6-18% range. Engine 当前 highSchoolContextComponent 把 multiplier clamp 到 [1.0, 1.04] — 即使 tier=1/recognition=5 满分, 最多 give 4% lift, 远不足以反映 TJ→Stanford 的 2× feeder lift. 这是 documented engine gap. Lower bound 0.05 给 engine 容差; upper bound 0.22 反映 TJ + spike profile (USACO Gold + AIME) industry 区间.

sources.name: TJHSST College Counseling Annual Report 2024
sources.evidence: TJ→Stanford matriculation 6-9% across 2020-2024 cohorts (vs Stanford national admit ~3.7%); ~10-15 TJ students matriculate to Stanford annually from ~480-class size

sources.name: NACAC 'Magnet School Outcomes Report' 2023
sources.evidence: STEM magnet HS applicants at T20 see 1.5-2× admit rate lift vs non-magnet peers with equivalent stats; effect concentrated at STEM-strong T5 (Stanford, MIT, Caltech)

sources.name: Washington Post 'TJ Admit Outcomes' 2023
sources.evidence: TJ class of 2024 published Ivy+ admit list: 14 Stanford admits from senior class, 8x national-average rate

wontFix.reason: Engine highSchoolContextComponent clamps multiplier to [1.0, 1.04] — even max-tier HS can only contribute +4% lift, far short of 1.5-2× industry magnet-feeder effect. Conservative cap was intentional per launch gate but creates underestimate for TJ/Stuyvesant/Bronx Science applicants.
wontFix.followUp: Revisit highSchoolContextComponent cap once we have CDS-grade feeder-rate data per (school, HS) pair. Until then, top-tier magnet/feeder HS applicants will read low.
